releaseNotes: v0.2.1 (beta): currentLayer and totalLayers read 0 when not printing, and progress reads 0 when Idle, instead of keeping the last print's numbers. v0.2.0 (beta): New dashboard tile in the Moonraker driver's style. fileName says Not printing between prints and new lastPrint keeps the last file. eta is now ETA and shows -- instead of null. contact is now door (rules: Custom Attribute). v0.1.9 (beta): Edit Printer opens its own page. Tap Done there to save, and the main page shows every printer collapsed. v0.1.8 (beta): The chamber light on the printer card is a lightbulb: lit when on, crossed out when off. v0.1.7 (beta): On an idle printer, a command (like the chamber light) now confirms within a few seconds instead of at the next 5 minute check, and no longer counts as a missed status. v0.1.6 (beta): Error text now loads from the HMS folder on GitHub (0.1.5 looked in a lowercase hms folder and fell back to the Wiki home page). v0.1.5 (beta): The chamber light works in Monitor only and switches both H2D chamber lights. Printer errors in plain English with a Bambu Lab Wiki link. Door as a contact sensor, firmware update available, external spools. A refused command (no Developer Mode) is logged as refused instead of counted as a printer error, and every command is checked against the printer's next status. Time left and elapsed time show from the first status. v0.1.4 (beta): The printer's status no longer sticks on Connecting after an update while data is coming in. A reconnect shows as Reconnecting for the first 2 minutes instead of an offline warning. The printer card shows the model (H2D). v0.1.3 (beta): Connected printers show as a card (status, mode, AMS tray colors) with Edit Printer, Refresh and Remove Printer, like Sofabaton. Temperature units, temperature step and the check interval moved to each printer's Preferences tab; your current values carry over. The Advanced page is gone. v0.1.2 (beta): Tested on an H2D. Add printer and Remove printer buttons, control options only when control is picked (Stop off unless Allow Stop is on), a Tips & Troubleshooting page, and an Advanced page for the shared options. Setup needs only the IP and access code: the serial is read from the printer. Sampling instead of streaming: printing printers are checked every 30 seconds and idle ones every 5 minutes, instead of a full status every second. Temperatures in Celsius to match the printer (option for the hub's scale). Heater status (Heating to target, At temp, Cooling, Off) with the temperature only at temperature, in 5 degree steps, elapsed time, times in 5 minute steps. Pause, Resume, Stop and speed are one Printer Control command. Printers are recreated once on update (now keyed by slot), so recheck rules that use them. Main page banner matches Hubitat's built-in apps (gopher.ny).
author: jdthomas24

apps.name: Bambu Lab Integration
apps.description: Adds your Bambu Lab printers by IP, serial and access code, sets each one to Monitor only or Monitor and control, and lets you choose which devices Hubitat creates.

drivers.name: Bambu Lab Printer
drivers.description: One per printer: the local MQTT connection, print status, temperatures, errors and tile, plus print control in control mode. Created by the app.

drivers.name: Bambu Lab AMS
drivers.description: One per AMS unit: humidity, temperature, and filament type, color and amount for each tray.
